 Metro to offer free rides on Election Day to make in-person voting more accessible
 BY 
 Mariam Abaza
 Cincinnati 
 PUBLISHED 10:28 AM ET Oct. 22, 2026 
 PUBLISHED 10:28 AM EDT Oct. 22, 2026 
 SHARE 
 CINCINNATI, Ohio — Metro will make in-person voting more accessible by providing free transportation to the polls on Election Day. 
 On Nov. 3, the Fixed-route, Access, and MetroNow! Services will be fare-free to help Hamilton County voters get to the polls. 
 "Every voice matters, and transportation should never be a barrier to civic participation,” said Brandy Jones, the chief communications and marketing officer of Metro. “By offering free rides on Election Day, Metro is making it easier for residents to exercise their right to vote. It’s one more way we’re connecting our community to the opportunities and moments that matter most.”
 All Metro fixed-route buses will follow their regular schedules. Individuals with disabilities can use Access paratransit for door-to-door service. MetroNow! will offer a flexible, fare-free option for trips within its service zones. 
 Plan your Election Day route on the Transit app or book an on-demand ride on the MetroNow! app .
